findings.summary: A newer build that changes the `Carried` or `JobLine` fields silently drops the carry
findings.evidence: The carry is read by the newly rebuilt binary, which may have a changed `Carried` or `JobLine` shape, but neither struct has `#[serde(default)]`. A field added in the new build makes `serde_json::from_str` fail, and `take_carry` then returns None without a note. The summary falls back silently to last-pass-only, the very bug this change fixes. Simpler fix: add `#[serde(default)]` to `Carried` (and to new JobLine fields), and add a report note when a carry file exists but cannot be read.

findings.summary: The carry is lost if the continuing pass fails
findings.evidence: `take_carry` removes the file before `pass()?` runs. If that pass returns Err, the earlier passes' tallies are gone and no summary of them is printed. This is an edge case and is acceptable for now.

findings.summary: A carried `held_back` stays even when a later pass met the target
findings.evidence: `apply` keeps the earlier `held_back` when the last pass has none. If the last pass met the target, the summary can still print the 'held back' line next to 'target met'.

summary: I recommend accepting this change. After a rebuild, `athena drain` now writes the run's tallies so far to `drain.carry` in the state directory, then re-execs the new binary. Those tallies are landed, spend, the job lines (which are the jobs started), notes, rebases, improvement turns, the rating and held_back. The continuing process reads that file and adds it to its own report through `Carried::apply`, so the closing summary covers the whole run. The new process still gets only the remaining budget and job limit, so spend is not counted twice against them. A fresh drain discards any leftover carry file before it starts (in `guarded`). I ran `cargo test -p athena-cli drain` and the five new or related tests myself; all passed. The new tests check: two landings with a rebuild between them (landed 2, spent $1.60 of $9.00, both job lines in the printed text); three passes with two rebuilds and the budgets handed on (8.2 then 7.4); a fresh start, a stale carry, a carry owned by this drain, and an unreadable carry; and a failed exec leaving no file. Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test checks passed on this commit. The CHANGELOG entry and the module docs are present and match the code. All four changed files are on the expected list. I found two minor issues and a nit, none blocking. A newer build that changes the `Carried` or `JobLine` fields would silently drop the carry, because those fields have no serde defaults. The carry is also lost if a pass fails after reading it. And a carried `held_back` can still print even when a later pass met the target.
